original_test_intent: Write one approved asset tag through the authenticated OOB DCMI/FRU route, verify complete persistence and inventory correlation on the same hardware, then restore the authoritative baseline when required.
original_method: Retain LANPlus raw 0x2c 0x08 0xdc and the source route, but require immutable target binding, a complete getter baseline and one exact approved encoded tag before execution.
manual_activity: The asset/network owner approves the exact tag and encoding, immutable hardware identity, downstream inventory impact, maintenance window, fallback access and exact restore value.
required_inputs: Verified BMC endpoint, firmware and immutable SUT identity
Exact replacement tag and encoded bytes
safety_requirements: Do not execute the parameterless DeepSeek setter
Bind target independently of the tag
agent_execution_scope: Bind endpoint to immutable hardware identity
Issue one secret-safe OOB raw write
Read back complete tag and consumers
engineer_actions: Approve tag, target anchor, inventory impact and recovery
Prevent temporary ownership changes from propagating

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The shown `dcmi set_asset_tag` lacks the required tag argument and therefore cannot perform the claimed operation; password argv and absent raw/read-back evidence add further gaps.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After immutable target binding and approval, send one LANPlus raw 0x2c 0x08 0xdc 0 0x10 <approved-asset-tag-data>, re-prove the same BMC, read back the complete tag, check consumers and restore under the plan.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source OOB route, opcode, FRU prerequisite and 10/5 timing remain; no data bytes are inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run an identity-governed remote asset transaction anchored to immutable hardware/session evidence, with one approved value, complete raw read-back, downstream consumer checks and deterministic rollback.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an executable payload, remote attribution, inventory semantics and recovery beyond command-success acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IB setter evidence cannot establish LANPlus path, credential handling or remote attribution after the field used for asset labeling changes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A remote tag change can cause CMDB, provisioning and evidence systems to associate the session with another asset or ownership record.

project_override_considerations: A vendor/Redfish setter is equivalent only when it preserves immutable target proof, exact field semantics, complete read-back and consumer/restore evidence; omitted raw coverage must be disclosed.
expected_evidence: Secret-safe exact write request/response and completion

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master title, FRU prerequisite and OOB 0x08 command consistently describe an asset-tag write. Its placeholder and success-only criterion are insufficient but do not contradict the named operation; the parameterless DeepSeek command is an overlay defect.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and field are identifiable. Exact tag, encoding, target proof, baseline, approval, fallback and restore are concrete prerequisites.

review_improvement: Makes the remote asset-identity mutation executable only as an approved, independently attributed and fully reversible transaction.
independent_technical_reasoning: Because the command remotely changes a value used to identify the asset, later read-back can become circular evidence. Automation must anchor the BMC to immutable hardware before the write and revalidate that anchor afterward. Only then can complete tag bytes, external inventory behavior and restoration prove a safe setter lifecycle.
